description: Detailed source reading of the Droschinsky 2018 independent mapped/skipped optima, local step correctness, exhaustive child matching, well-founded rank, generic synchronous-round induction, and root/unrooted reference readout, with a four-state numerical table.

related_resources.reason: Rooted embedding recurrence, mapped/skipped states, and path penalties.
Lean theorem statements, well-founded induction, extensionality, and functional correctness.

learning_objectives: Distinguish independent boundary-state witness optima from the executable table that calculates them
Explain the exact dependency hypotheses of RootedDP.step_correct and why they are necessary
Trace exhaustively optimized child matching, list maxima, and the two recurrence equalities through the local proof
Prove conceptually why the combined remaining-depth rank strictly decreases on all dependency shapes
Use FiniteTable.rounds_correct to explain evaluate_correct and solve_correct and distinguish the all-root-pairs baseline from optimized runtime claims
